purpose: Exploratory staffing and assignable-capacity diagnosis under the frozen CONOPS; no policy comparison or policy change.

seed_block.note: Fixed before execution; disjoint from the repository's documented 20261127 and 20261128 blocks, confirmatory 20261129 block, and historical 998001/910000-930000/711000000 blocks.

L1_4.selection_rule: Nested reduction from L1_5 by excluding L1-03. L1-04 and L1-05 retain all-class coverage; the effect of removing L1-03's distinct top5/tail competence and speed is measured, not treated as interchangeable.

L1_3.selection_rule: Nested reduction from L1_4 by excluding L1-02. L1-04 and L1-05 retain all-class coverage; the reduced roster retains the faster top5 profile L1-01 and higher next5/tail competence profile L1-05. L1-02's distinct faster tail service is lost and assessed.

L2_2.selection_rule: Nested reduction from L2_3 by excluding L2-03. Both retained analysts remain eligible for every project; the change in class-specific speed/competence is measured.

L2_1.selection_rule: Nested reduction from L2_2 by excluding L2-02. L2-01 covers all projects; this is only a mathematical capacity bound under continuous individual availability, not an operational recommendation because it leaves no redundancy or realistic relief.

interpretation.primary_scope: organizational capacity and staffing only; D1/L1 and P1/L2 are held fixed
interpretation.not_a_claim: No empirical validation of service, quality, arrival process, label prevalence, or staffing practice.
